newsitem.title: UK: Goldman Sachs cuts UK bank sector to underweight.
newsitem.headline: Goldman Sachs cuts UK bank sector to underweight.

text.p: Goldman Sachs said on Friday it cut its rating on the UK bank sector to "underweight" from neutral.
The investment bank last reduced its rating on the sector on May 12, when it went from "overweight" to "neutral."
In its latest move, Goldman cited its belief that UK interest rates will rise 100 basis points in the next 12 months.
"It's also based on valuations relative to other sectors," a Goldman source said.
The UK bank sector has been a runaway outperformer in recent weeks ahead of the Halifax Building Society flotation on June 2.
Most bank shares were down on Friday as investors took profits ahead of the flotation next week, dealers said.
